# Three-Minute Proof Plan Delta

The Awtsmoos renews the plan when evidence changes the road;
Awtsmoos.com keeps one truth in many vessels, never a duplicated load.

## Why the prior implementation map changed

The prior Sol addendum proposed a new `apps/shared/movie` package. During collision checks, another active movie-unification worker materialized the intended renderer-neutral contract at `libs/awtsmoos-movie-core`, including movie defaults, feature discovery, validation, easing, and keyframe interpolation. Creating a second core would violate the unification goal, so this pass will consume that living package and will not rewrite its concurrently-owned files.

## Owned proof surface

This pass owns only new, collision-checked three-minute proof files:

- `apps/animator/src/scenes/showcase/UnifiedShowcaseCanonicalMovie.js` — exact 180-second AI-facing 2D/3D/hybrid document using the neutral core.
- `apps/animator/src/scenes/showcase/UnifiedThreeMinuteShowcaseMovie.js` — exact 180-second production cut derived from the first six proven Four Minute Festival worlds, preserving people, dialogue, acting, cameras, audio/edit metadata, and 24 shots.
- `apps/animator/tools/render/showcase/ShowcaseShapePainter.js` — animated 2D geometry, paths, arrows, patches, and pseudo-3D wire geometry.
- `apps/animator/tools/render/showcase/ShowcaseParticlePainter.js` — deterministic multi-style particles.
- `apps/animator/tools/render/showcase/ShowcaseInfographicPainter.js` — animated charts, tutorial steps, text, and node diagrams.
- `apps/animator/tools/render/showcase/UnifiedShowcaseFeaturePainter.js` — scene-local feature choreography.
- `apps/animator/tools/render/UnifiedThreeMinuteFrameRenderer.js` — wrapper around the proven cinematic renderer; no fork of its camera/cast/set logic.
- `apps/animator/tools/render/exportUnifiedThreeMinuteMovie.js` — real FFmpeg H.264/AAC export plus FFprobe evidence.
- `apps/animator/tools/verify/unifiedThreeMinuteMovieSmoke.js` — structural and canonical-contract verification.

## Proof rules

The movie must be exactly 180000ms, 640x360, 12fps, six distinct 30-second worlds, twenty-four camera shots, five recurring people, dialogue/performance clips, actual rendered text, animated shapes, paths, particles, chart/tutorial graphics, patches, and pseudo-3D geometry. The canonical document must validate through `awtsmoos-movie-core` and explicitly include 2D, 3D, and hybrid scenes. The exported MP4 must be verified by FFprobe as H.264 video + AAC audio with duration within 0.5 seconds of 180 seconds.

## Collision rule

Every path above must be confirmed absent immediately before creation. Existing Animator source files remain untouched because concurrent agents are actively modifying them. All implementation files are complete-file writes, tab-indented, non-minified, documented, and kept at or below the project line ceiling.
